objective: Build NZD 1,000,000 of liquid personal wealth as rapidly as legally and sustainably possible.
principle: Optimize for cash generation, margin, distribution, repeatability, ownership and compounding, not software activity.
economic_rules: No revenue is counted until payment is independently verified.
Prefer high-margin digital delivery and productized services before inventory-heavy expansion.
Every new engineering task must increase acquisition, conversion, fulfilment, retention, proof or measurement.
Kill offers that fail repeated demand tests; scale offers with verified demand.
Protect cash and reinvest only where expected return is measurable.

market_signal.source_notes: Current 2026 NZ research indicates rapid online-commerce growth and emerging AI-mediated shopping demand.
